changeSet.author: nexus-brxnp
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_restore_rereferenced_bounded: ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, collection, chash) DO NOTHING instead of DO UPDATE, so a LIVE origin row (one that already exists at restore time) is never overwritten by an older quarantine copy. The quarantine copy is still deleted either way. Also records `already_live` in the gc_audit details (rows the DO NOTHING conflict skipped versus rows genuinely inserted), via one new GET DIAGNOSTICS read -- RETURNS and the returned counts are unchanged. Byte-identical to catalog-042-1's body otherwise. DATA EFFECT: none -- a function-body replacement only (see this file's own header).
